claims.value: Olmo 3 7B RL-Zero IF is a 7B-parameter Transformer autoregressive language model trained on the Dolci-RL-Zero-IF-7B dataset for instruction following using reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.
claims.evidence: The RL-Zero family of models is an experimental set of model for the scientific exploration of RLVR training. ... reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on the Dolci-RL-Zero-IF-7B dataset which consists of instruction-following queries.
**Model type:** a Transformer style autoregressive language model. **Language(s) (NLP):** English
Long chain-of-thought thinking improves reasoning tasks like math and coding.
